QuestInfo.name: A Fresh Start
QuestInfo.0: Many things have changed, but the Xuanshan School will continue.
QuestInfo.1: Feng is wandering around near the Pianran Pavilion. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.2:
After the students' first real battle, they're fired up and begin training on their own. Xiao Xiao's bright smile returned. 
Yun Hao will handle administration, Yun Jing the training, and Feng whatever's needed. Many things have changed, but the Xuanshan School will continue.
